# Targeted therapy

**Status: blocked — qualifying targeted-therapy exposure is not operationally
defined.**

Before analysis, the future schema must include `id`, `treatment_id`,
`treatment_line`, `treatment_name`, controlled `targeted_therapy` classification,
`targeted_class`, `start_date`, `stop_date`, treatment indication/alteration
linkage, and an exposure-completeness flag.  The protocol must specify whether
targeted therapy means any targeted agent, an OncoKB-actionable agent, or a
therapy linked to a qualifying ctDNA alteration.

The current optional `targeted_therapy` flag has no qualifying definition,
agent class, linkage, or observation window.  It cannot support a valid
patient-level denominator or comparative model and is not recoded from
current aggregate fields.
